glasses-finder.shortDescription: Find glasses by face shape, prescription, fit, style, and budget.
glasses-finder.longDescription: Glasses Finder helps shoppers compare physical eyeglass frames by face shape, frame width, prescription type, progressive-lens support, material, style, blue-light preference, and budget. It explains fit tradeoffs and reminds users to verify prescription and measurements with the merchant.
starterPrompts: Find progressive glasses under $200 that suit a round face.
Find lightweight frames for a narrow square face.
Compare medium-width glasses with blue-light lenses.
glasses-finder.affiliateDisclosure: Glasses Finder may earn a commission when users buy through partner links. Recommendations rank user fit first.
glasses-finder.safetyPolicy: Provide shopping guidance, not eye-care diagnosis. Users must confirm their prescription, pupillary distance, measurements, lens options, and final price with the merchant or an eye-care professional.
